chat_baseline.answer_extraction: Strip everything through final </think>; open reasoning is empty answer; retain raw outputs and format metrics.
chat_baseline.purpose: Pre-pilot format/quality baseline; source few-shot scores remain a separate protocol.
chat_baseline.selection: SHA256-ranked stable IDs, seed 20261018; source subset manifest frozen before inference

eight_node.pass: All 32 ranks complete; finite loss throughout; capture post-compilation throughput and per-rank memory; native/HF checkpoint complete.
eight_node.scope: Performance-only pilot; full production is not automatically launched.

long_context.classification: Baseline/smoke measurements characterize current checkpoints. Production promotion requires stage checkpoint targets plus short-context noninferiority; poor baseline scores are reported as failures, never passed.
long_context.implementation: Installed lm-eval 0.4.13 RULER, snapshot code hashes before generation
long_context.selection: First 100 of upstream deterministic 500-example generator at each context; freeze prompt IDs and measured token lengths.
long_context.tasks: All 13 RULER tasks; report NIAH tasks separately
long_context.truncation: Forbidden; any oversized prompt or HTTP truncation is an infrastructure failure.

short_context_noninferiority.fail: Any adjusted confidence upper bound is below -margin.
short_context_noninferiority.multipl_e: Equal language weight; resample shared original problem IDs jointly across languages.
short_context_noninferiority.otherwise: inconclusive; never treat non-significance or repeated identical greedy runs as proof of preservation.
short_context_noninferiority.pass: Every metric point estimate and Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided paired confidence lower bound is at least -margin.

short_context_protocol: Existing 4096-token greedy plain-text base_fewshot suite, same prompts, sample IDs, BOS, budgets and task versions.
